label.description: The visible label, which also names the calendar. Without one, the calendar needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.

value.description: The selected range as YYYY-MM-DD start and end dates, when the caller controls it. null keeps a controlled calendar empty. A string that is not a valid date throws a TypeError.

defaultValue.description: The starting selected range, when the calendar controls itself.

focusedValue.description: The focused date as YYYY-MM-DD, when the caller controls it. It is separate from the selected range, and controlling it also controls the month shown. Moving focus does not select.

minValue.description: The earliest date, inclusive, that can be focused or selected.

maxValue.description: The latest date, inclusive, that can be focused or selected.

unavailableDateMatcher.description: Returns true for a date that is unavailable, given as a YYYY-MM-DD string. An unavailable date can take focus but cannot be selected.

disabled.description: Disables the calendar: no date can be focused or selected.

readOnly.description: Makes the calendar read-only: focus still moves between dates, but selecting a range does nothing.

required.description: Marks the calendar required. It currently has no effect on a calendar, which submits no form value.

invalid.description: Forces the invalid state when true. Left false, validation follows the selected range, so a date before minValue, after maxValue, or marked unavailable still makes the calendar invalid.

change.description: Called with the range the user selects, as YYYY-MM-DD start and end dates, once both are chosen. It is not called while the calendar is disabled or read-only.

focusChange.description: Called with the focused date as YYYY-MM-DD when focus moves to another date, by the arrow keys or the month buttons. It is not called while the calendar is disabled.

MuxUIDateRange.description: A range of calendar dates, both ends included.

MuxUIDateValue.description: A calendar date as an ISO string, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with no time or time zone.
